name: rockys-retreat-and-rambles
description: Rocky's Retreat and Rambles — Next.js app (frontend lives in /frontend, copied to root at build time).

scripts.build: set -e && cd frontend && yarn install --network-timeout 600000 && yarn build && cd .. && rm -rf .next public && cp -r frontend/.next .next && cp -r frontend/public public && echo 'Build copied to root successfully'
